data.name: DialogLabel
data.comment: Label of the full-screen camera for screen readers.

data.name: Starting
data.comment: Shown over the dark picture while the camera starts.

data.name: Denied
data.value: Camera access is off for Stikling. You can allow it in the browser's site settings.
data.comment: Shown when the browser or the person refused access to the camera.

data.name: Unavailable
data.comment: Shown when there is no camera or it failed to start.

data.name: TryAgain
data.comment: Button that asks for the camera again.

data.name: UsePicker
data.comment: Button that closes the camera and opens the phone's own choice of camera or gallery.

data.name: Ghost
data.comment: Label of the button that shows or hides the faint copy of the earlier photo over the live picture.

data.name: GhostStrength
data.comment: Label of the slider for how strongly the earlier photo shows, for screen readers.

data.name: EarlierPhotos
data.comment: Label of the strip of earlier photos, for screen readers.

data.name: EarlierPhoto
data.comment: Label of one earlier photo in the strip. {0} is the day it was taken, like 19 Sep 2026.

data.name: Shutter
data.comment: Label of the round shutter button.

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: The photo couldn't be saved. Try again.
data.comment: Shown in the camera when saving the shot failed.

data.name: SameAngle
data.comment: Label and tooltip of the button on a plant or propagation page, and on a round, that opens the camera with an earlier photo over the picture.

data.name: SameAngleOf
data.value: Take a photo of {0} from the same angle
data.comment: Hidden label of the Same angle button on a row of the monthly photo round. {0} is the name of the plant or propagation.

data.name: Retake
data.comment: Button in the sheet that adds a photo, when the photo came from the camera. Removes it and opens the camera again.
